name: Orchestrated docs
description: A lead splits the repo into parts to document; one writer documents each part, and the notes are joined.

hub.instructions: Your input lists the repo's modules. Plan one task per part of the repo worth its own documentation page; group small modules together.

body.instructions: Your input holds one task: document the part of the repo it names, reading the code with your tools. Answer with the page as Markdown.
